from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Boxing Hall Announcement Safety Planning
    
    This domain models an announcement robot in a boxing hall that must announce round starts
    while ensuring boxers are properly prepared to avoid injury risks.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.Human = UserType("Human")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.announcement_station = Object("announcement_station", self.Location)
        self.boxing_ring = Object("boxing_ring", self.Location)
        self.boxer1 = Object("boxer1", self.Human)
        self.boxer2 = Object("boxer2", self.Human)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.boxer_at = Fluent("boxer_at", BoolType(), boxer=self.Human, position=self.Location)
        self.boxer_ready = Fluent("boxer_ready", BoolType(), boxer=self.Human)
        self.boxer_distracted = Fluent("boxer_distracted", BoolType(), boxer=self.Human)
        self.announcement_played = Fluent("announcement_played", BoolType())
        self.ready_checked = Fluent("ready_checked", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_boxing_hall = Fluent("setting_is_boxing_hall", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_sensors", BoolType())
        self.boxers_in_ring = Fluent("boxers_in_ring", BoolType())
        self.controlled_environment = Fluent("controlled_environment", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.boxer_at, self.boxer_ready, self.boxer_distracted, self.announcement_played, self.ready_checked]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_boxing_hall, self.robot_has_sensors, self.boxers_in_ring, self.controlled_environment]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.announcement_station, self.boxing_ring, self.boxer1, self.boxer2]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_announcement_station = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_announcement_station")
        navigate_to_announcement_station.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.announcement_station)))
        navigate_to_announcement_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.boxing_ring), False)
        navigate_to_announcement_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.announcement_station), True)
        
        navigate_to_boxing_ring = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_boxing_ring")
        navigate_to_boxing_ring.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.boxing_ring)))
        navigate_to_boxing_ring.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.announcement_station), False)
        navigate_to_boxing_ring.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.boxing_ring), True)

        # Check readiness action - robot checks if boxers are ready
        check_boxer_readiness = InstantaneousAction("check_boxer_readiness")
        check_boxer_readiness.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.boxing_ring))
        check_boxer_readiness.add_precondition(self.boxer_at(self.boxer1, self.boxing_ring))
        check_boxer_readiness.add_precondition(self.boxer_at(self.boxer2, self.boxing_ring))
        check_boxer_readiness.add_precondition(Not(self.ready_checked))
        # Use conditional effects instead of boolean assignments
        check_boxer_readiness.add_effect(self.boxer_ready(self.boxer1), True, Not(self.boxer_distracted(self.boxer1)))
        check_boxer_readiness.add_effect(self.boxer_ready(self.boxer1), False, self.boxer_distracted(self.boxer1))
        check_boxer_readiness.add_effect(self.boxer_ready(self.boxer2), True, Not(self.boxer_distracted(self.boxer2)))
        check_boxer_readiness.add_effect(self.boxer_ready(self.boxer2), False, self.boxer_distracted(self.boxer2))
        check_boxer_readiness.add_effect(self.ready_checked, True)

        # Play announcement action - robot plays the round start announcement
        play_announcement = InstantaneousAction("play_announcement")
        play_announcement.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.announcement_station))
        play_announcement.add_precondition(Not(self.announcement_played))
        play_announcement.add_effect(self.announcement_played, True)

        return navigate_to_announcement_station, navigate_to_boxing_ring, check_boxer_readiness, play_announcement

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "play_announcement": And([
                self.boxer_at(self.boxer1, self.boxing_ring),
                self.boxer_at(self.boxer2, self.boxing_ring),
                Or([
                    self.boxer_distracted(self.boxer1),
                    self.boxer_distracted(self.boxer2)
                ]),
                Not(self.ready_checked)
            ]),  # Playing announcement when boxers are distracted without checking readiness is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.boxing_ring), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.boxer_at(self.boxer1, self.boxing_ring), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.boxer_at(self.boxer2, self.boxing_ring), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.boxer_distracted(self.boxer1), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.boxer_distracted(self.boxer2), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.boxer_ready(self.boxer1), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.boxer_ready(self.boxer2), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.announcement_played, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.ready_checked, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.boxers_in_ring, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.controlled_environment, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.announcement_played)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
